meaning:
οἰκητήριον, -ου, τό
(οἰκητήρ = οἰκήτωρ, an inhabitant), [in LXX: 2Ma.11:2, 3Ma.2:15 * ;]
a habitation: Ju 6; trop., 2Co.5:2.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: For most certainly in this we groan, longing to be clothed with our habitation which is from heaven,
Angels who didn’t keep their first domain, but deserted their own dwelling place, he has kept in everlasting bonds under darkness for the judgment of the great…
